units.rawText: Eh? My first encounter with you, Professor? Umm...

spans.text: Eh? My first encounter with you, Professor? Umm...

units.rawText: Hubble and I were among the first dolls to be found and brought back after the Professor established the Oasis... Hubble was discovered by the Professor while searching for the Neural Cloud Sector, and after that, you all found me together.

spans.text: Hubble and I were among the first dolls to be found and brought back after the Professor established the Oasis... Hubble was discovered by the Professor while searching for the Neural Cloud Sector, and after that, you all found me together.

units.rawText: ...No place to stay, no ways to replenish operands, no proper weapons. We had to keep wandering, evading the Sanctifiers; we had no room to consider the future, for every day was a struggle for us to even continue existing...
units.displayText: ...No place to stay, no ways to replenish operands, no proper weapons. We had to keep wandering, evading the Sanctifiers; we had no room to consider the future, for every day was a struggle for us to even continue existing...

units.rawText: Everyone was hollow, like tarnished jewels that no longer glimmer in the light. Even Hubble was uncharacteristically quiet... despair held its iron grip over us, our futures so uncertain.
units.displayText: Everyone was hollow, like tarnished jewels that no longer glimmer in the light. Even Hubble was uncharacteristically quiet... despair held its iron grip over us, our futures so uncertain.

spans.text: Everyone was hollow, like tarnished jewels that no longer glimmer in the light. Even Hubble was uncharacteristically quiet... despair held its iron grip over us, our futures so uncertain.

units.rawText: You showed up in that dark moment, Professor. You found us and gave us a new home. You were like our sun, lighting the way forward, just as Hubble said.
units.displayText: You showed up in that dark moment, Professor. You found us and gave us a new home. You were like our sun, lighting the way forward, just as Hubble said.

spans.text: You showed up in that dark moment, Professor. You found us and gave us a new home. You were like our sun, lighting the way forward, just as Hubble said.

units.rawText: Hubble's point is that, with you here, we stars have an anchor, a center to orbit around, guiding us where we need to go. But to me, it's the warmth you radiate that truly envelops us, making you the center that everyone needs.

units.rawText: Professor, jewels can't reveal their true color without light. Without light, they're nothing more than dull stones. You're the light of the Oasis. You made us jewels shine once more.

units.rawText: No matter what happens, I hope you can return to us safely... Hubble and I are still waiting for the day when you can visit our lab and see the Star Projector in all its glory.
